content:
- name: Enforce third-party actions are pinned to commit SHA
  run: |
    while IFS= read -r file; do
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        token=$(echo "$line" | sed -n 's/.*uses:\s*\([^#[:space:]]*\).*/\1/p')
        token=${token#\"}; token=${token%\"}
        token=${token#\'} ; token=${token%\'}
        if [[ "$token" == *@* ]]; then
          ref=${token#*@}
          if ! [[ "$ref" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Action not pinned to commit SHA: $token in $file"
            exit 1
          fi
        fi
      done < <(grep -E '^\s*uses:' "$file")
    done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \))
    exit 0
